supporting_features.feature_phrase: raised section along the lower perimeter
supporting_features.evidence: A portion of the printed lower edge sits visibly above the build-plate surface while another portion remains lower.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: visible gap beneath the printed base
supporting_features.evidence: A dark open space is visible between part of the object's underside and the build plate.
The bottom boundary bends upward toward a raised edge instead of remaining straight and level across the plate.
The base contacts the plate in some regions but is separated from it in other visible regions.
